column1: # One row per kernel. Columns are TAB-separated:
#   category    path(relative to repo root)    size    slow_path_tag
# `size` is passed to the program after `--` (an Int loop bound, a fib arg, or a
# fixture path for the selfhost cases). Lines starting with `#` are ignored.
# Coverage goal: every major slow path (anything the native Cranelift tier does
# NOT cover) has at least one focused kernel here. Int-arith/control kernels are
# kept as the fast-path baseline to measure the others against.
# --- JIT hot path: native-ELIGIBLE kernels (native actually compiles + runs).
# These are the only kernels where nat/reg should drop well below 1.0; they are
# the regression anchors for the native tier itself.
# --- VM slow paths (native bails or is not eligible).
struct-nested       benchmarks/vm-jit/kernels/nested_struct_field.rss            300000    nested struct build + a.b.c reads
closure-dynamic     benchmarks/vm-jit/kernels/dynamic_closure_call.rss           200000    stored owned Fn dynamic call
